tasks.description: Hold Google Barkour vB in an upright standing posture at the current location.
tasks.criterion_summary: Experimental upright-score, planar-speed, and no-floor-contact checks.

tasks.description: Adjust Google Barkour vB to the specified body height and hold upright at the current location.
tasks.criterion_summary: Experimental body-height and upright checks; threshold is not physically calibrated.

tasks.description: Move Google Barkour vB forward in its initial body-yaw direction for a bounded distance, then stop upright.
tasks.criterion_summary: Experimental forward-displacement, lateral-drift, settle-speed, and contact checks.

tasks.description: Move Google Barkour vB laterally in its initial body-yaw frame for a bounded distance, then stop upright.
tasks.criterion_summary: Experimental lateral-displacement, forward-drift, settle-speed, and contact checks.

tasks.description: Move the four Google Barkour vB legs to the specified symmetric posture and hold it.
tasks.criterion_summary: Experimental 12-joint leg-vector error check; target and tolerance are not physically calibrated.
